Theorem A's tame embedding into B = Γ''\Ω needs Ω simply connected (π₁(B) is an extension of Γ'' by π₁(Ω)); the paper's Ω are convex, but this has to be carried.

GHFspace.tex:3586-3590, 3616-3618: for translation spacetimes [11.i] does not need Theorem A applied to the target: the lift of f∘π : 𝐌ⁿ → N to Ñ, composed with 𝒟_N, is a global isometry g, so F∘g⁻¹ is a global section of 𝒟_N whose range is clopen; translation spacetimes are absolutely maximal among all flat targets, GH or not, and every local isometry out of them is onto (absMax_of_isTranslationSpacetime, no sorry).

Family (b) (IsCHCentralExtensionOf, Loxodromic, Def 4.18 l.1212-1214) asks 'no global fixed point', not 'nonelementary': it admits elementary groups with a loxodromic element (infinite dihedral), so A's fourth disjunct is slightly broader than BARBOT-THEOREMS §1 (A's conclusion slightly weaker than R1 as drafted); faithful to Def 4.18, and the Misner disjunct covers that case up to finite index.

Family (b)'s GH needs a loxodromic element of Γ; Def 4.18's 'discrete without global fixed point' yields one only through the classification of elementary groups, not invoked by Barbot here. Derived from Benoist (BenoistNoLox, already in BarbotExternals) by averaging a finite orbit (exists_loxodromic_of_not_hasGlobalFixedPoint): no new hypothesis.

The past sides (Misner past wedge GH by direct computation; family (b) past side by time reversal τ: τΩ⁻(Λ) = Ω⁺(−Λ), and g ↦ τgτ is an automorphism of Isom(𝐌ⁿ) though τ is not in it, revConj) reuse the future-only cosmological-time lemmas of Examples.

An IsQuotientOf presentation with M Hausdorff already makes the action free and properly discontinuous (IsQuotientOf.isCancelSMul / properlyDiscontinuousSMul): the instances gh_of_isQuotientOf asks need not be carried.

Translation spacetimes are Cauchy-complete through the projected slice π(φ{t=0}), whose induced length is the quotient length of ℝᵈ by Λ: q : ℝᵈ → S is 1-Lipschitz and lifts short paths to short segments (the covering restricted to π⁻¹(S) = φ{t=0}); the Misner slice is flat in (η, z) and admits the same proof once its pulled length is computed.

kb_proposals: A local isometry descends along a surjective local isometry (IsLocalIsometry.of_comp_right) and cancels an isometric embedding on the left (of_comp_left): with these, a map out of a quotient or into an open subset is checked on the cover / on the ambient space.

In a proof about a developing pair, never `set q := UniversalCover.proj M x₀`: `set` rewrites the type of ρ : Deck (proj …) →* isom d into a shadowing copy, and hypotheses about the old ρ stop matching (`ρ✝ γ = ρ γ`).
The deck group of the ported universal cover is transitive on fibres: leftMul by cb·ca⁻¹ (UniversalCover.exists_deck_apply_eq).

A local isometry out of Γ\𝐌ⁿ is onto: lift to Ñ (mathlib existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts; 𝐌ⁿ and convex Ω are SimplyConnectedSpace via Convex.contractibleSpace), compose with 𝒟_N, rigidity (developing_unique_of_preconnected with D := Subtype.val) gives g, and range F = {z | F(g⁻¹•𝒟 z) = z} is closed (Ñ T2, t2Space_universalCover) and open.

IsLocalIsometry d f and IsGXMorphism (isom d) (Minkowski d) f differ only in form: convert with `isLocalIsometry_iff_eventually.1 h |> fun h' => ⟨h'.1, h'.2⟩` (anonymous constructor on the raw IsLocalIsometry fails: its second field is an EventuallyEq of compositions).

GH in the IsQuotientOf form: IsQuotientOf.exists_homeomorph's Φ is a local isometry by IsLocalIsometry.of_comp_right along FlatQuotient.proj; GH transfers along a surjective isometric embedding (gh_of_isQuotientOf).

The end of a lifting argument for a convex domain: if F : Ω → Ñ lifts f ∘ π with 𝒟 ∘ F = g|Ω and range 𝒟 ⊆ gΩ, then σ := F ∘ g⁻¹ ∘ 𝒟 is defined on all of Ñ and range F = {σ z = z} is clopen (Classification.surjective_of_lift_of_range_subset); equivariance of the lift comes free from uniqueness of lifts + transitivity of the deck group on fibres + Causal.eq_of_eqOn (exists_deck_of_lift).

Absolute maximality of a quotient of a regular domain needs only, on the target, the bridge (𝒟_N injective into Ω(S̃_N)) and Loxodromic's omegaS_subset_quadrant per loxodromic element of the model's group: no classification of the target (Theorem A on N) is used.

To move a point off a null hyperplane inside an open set, perturb along (∓1, 0): ⟨(1,u) | p + t(∓1,0)⟩ = ⟨(1,u) | p⟩ ± t, and fun_prop proves the continuity of t ↦ p + t • v.

Past statements for regular domains from the future ones: the time reversal τ (t,x) ↦ (−t,x) is not in isom d, but g ↦ τgτ is (revConj, via mem_lorentz_of_future); τΩ⁻(Λ) = Ω⁺(−Λ) and ≤ of 𝐌ⁿ reverses (le_top_timeRev), and on a future-complete open set ≤_⊤ is ≤_W (le_of_le_top_of_segment_subset). The quotient presentation transports along the homeomorphism τ even though τ is not an isometry, because freeness/proper discontinuity only use the covering and its fibres (isCancelSMul_of_isCoveringMap).
